verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two thin pieces of BugSnag's own SDK enrichment. The iOS SDK's appHangCallback lets developers add diagnostic context (e.g. current screen) when a hang is detected. Correlated Events groups events by shared user, device and session, which implies user and device context travels with each event. Missing for 10: any documentation of breadcrumbs, custom tags/metadata on every event (not just app hangs), an explicit user-context API, cross-platform coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
